evals.prompt: I have a JSONL file at /home/z/my-project/upload/qa_pairs.jsonl with about 800 rows, each like {"question": "...", "context": "...", "answer": "..."}. Package it as a HuggingFace dataset with a 90/10 train/test split under cc-by-4.0 so I can fine-tune on it.
evals.expected_output: A complete dataset directory with sharded parquet (train-00000-of-0000N.parquet naming), README.md with valid YAML frontmatter (license, language, task_categories, configs, dataset_info with num_examples per split), LICENSE file, create_dataset.py provenance script, passing smoke_test.py. The SQuAD-style or instruction-style schema is chosen and declared explicitly.

evals.prompt: Build me a 4-way multiple-choice benchmark called chem-bench from these 120 questions I exported from our quiz platform (CSV: question,option_a,option_b,option_c,option_d,correct_letter). Make sure the answer options stay balanced across a train/test split and the Hub viewer shows the answer as a dropdown.
evals.expected_output: benchmark-mcq features spec with ClassLabel answer; CSV cells type-coerced; stratified split on the ClassLabel so A/B/C/D balance is preserved across splits; README YAML declares answer as class_label (not string) so the Viewer renders a dropdown; validation run including ClassLabel balance check; complete packaged dataset passing smoke test.

evals.prompt: Convert our support-chat export (a folder of JSON files, each a multi-turn conversation between customer and agent) into a dataset my team can use for DPO preference training. Give each row the prompt plus chosen and rejected agent responses — we already marked the better reply with a 'preferred' flag.
evals.expected_output: preference-dpo schema (prompt, chosen: [{role, content}], rejected: [{role, content}], score fields if ratings exist); the message-list form (not flat strings); chosen/rejected share the same prompt prefix; score_chosen > score_rejected invariant validated; YAML dataset_info renders chosen/rejected as list of structs; full four-artifact packaging.
